item.tib: rig 'dzin 'dus thabs chen mkha' yi rgyud phun tshogs ngo mtshar rgyas pa las nang gtor ma'i bskang ba
item.coloph: dpon gsas bla ma'i bsgrub (sgrub) pa phun tshogs ngo mtshar rgyas pa'i rgyud las nang gtor ma'i bskang ba'i cho ga bla chen khod spungs kyis gtan la phab nas/ stong dmu tsha gyer med la gdams pa'o/ des phyi rabs las ldan gyi gshen (mchan blo ldan snying po) la brgyud pa'o//
